walkthrough: Goal: Drawabox's contour lines on organic forms (截面线): how a bending tube turns in space, told by its cross-sections, each an ellipse whose minor axis lies along the spine and whose degree opens where the tube turns towards me and closes where it runs across. The app lays the exact sections over my drawing and my eye judges it (D123).

Entry: unit 8's tile Contours (before Form intersections and Contrast thumbnails), or Start when it is next; no pack is needed. A lesson holds one sausage, about 4 minutes. Level 1: one gentle bend going back in depth, its spine printed, four ticks, the near end's contour given; level 2: one strong bend turning towards me, its spine printed, five ticks; level 3: an S-bend passing in front of itself, no spine, five or six ticks, only the half of each section that faces me drawn, and a small one round each end.

How, first time: A bending tube by its sections; how a bending tube turns in space, told by the ellipses round it. The example plays beside its picture, both frames cropped to the tube: 1 the spine followed over the picture in pencil; 2 at each tick the minor axis along the spine; 3 the ellipses round them in ink, touching the outline, the first a little off; 4 Compare: the exact ellipses red, their far halves dashed red. One paragraph says the minor axis always lies along the spine, the ellipse opens rounder where the tube turns towards me and closes flatter where it runs across, to draw each one through twice round, and at Steady only the half that faces me and a small one round each end. Got it.

The exercise: the left frame holds the sausage lit on paper, lying on the ground and going back to the left, seen from a little above. My frame holds its outline printed grey, its spine dashed faint, a pair of short ticks across the outline at four places, and at the near end's tick the given contour, its far half dashed. The tools: Sketch, Draw, Undo, Redo; Compare once something is drawn.
With Sketch I put a short minor axis along the spine at each tick; with Draw an ellipse round each, touching the outline at its ticks, the far ones flatter; but my first is far too round (a mistake).

Compare: each section's exact ellipse in see-through red over my ink, the half the tube hides dashed red; my first ellipse bulges past the red. The card: Contours 1, Construction, How close is it?, Accurate, Almost, Again; no reason, nothing ringed, no number. The pen is blue (Correct). Construction lays the spine in pencil, each section's square dashed with its four middles dotted; tapped again, it goes.

I redraw the first ellipse flatter on the red in blue and Compare again; I choose Almost, kept with the exercise once. Finish: the lesson's end, Contours, 1 exercise, its result. One more: the next sausage on the next row of the same sheet.
Reopen: Home leaves it under way; Continue on the home reopens it as it was.

Level 2 (熟练): a sausage running across, then turning towards me, five ticks, its sections opening as it turns; Compare and Construction as before. Level 3 (稳): an S-bend whose near part passes in front of its far part, the outline printed with the edge where it does, no spine; Compare lays every section and the two round the ends, their hidden halves dashed. I choose Again; Finish; That's all for today: the home offers it again on the side. All units, Unit 8: Contours, Form intersections, Contrast thumbnails.
Chinese: s156-contours-zh runs this walk-through on a Chinese tablet: 截面线, 用截面线画弯曲的管子, the steps 顺着中轴看：哪一段朝你转过来，哪一段转开, 用草稿笔在每个刻度处画短轴，顺着中轴, 用勾线笔绕短轴画椭圆，两边贴住轮廓, 叠图对比; the card 看画法, 准, 差一点, 重来.
